title: Uncommitted Feature Extraction Save/Discard Table
feature: KIND external viewer HTML compact metadata extraction
storage_goal: Efficient per-disclosure storage: keep values that change by disclosure, classify repeated static viewer/UI metadata as discard candidates.
current_implementation_rule: Tests and compressed JSON currently preserve all extracted data. This file classifies each extracted field with save_or_discard so filtering can be applied later without losing review visibility.
classification_basis: save when the value is likely disclosure-specific or needed to fetch/identify the correct document.
save when the value supports integrity checks or joins with source disclosure rows.
discard when the value is mostly static KIND viewer shell, repeated UI text, generic item labels, icons, common scripts, or common resources.
discard does not mean useless forever; it means not recommended for efficient per-disclosure storage unless real sample variance proves otherwise.

rows.reason: Primary disclosure-specific receipt number.
rows.source: viewer_html parsed payload or HTML filename stem

rows.reason: Disclosure title changes by filing and is useful for search, review, and downstream grouping.
Usually contains disclosure/company context that varies by filing.
rows.source: viewer_html parsed header or <h1 class="ttl"> fallback

rows.reason: Identifies the active main document for this disclosure.
rows.source: selected main document option in viewer HTML

rows.reason: The same document numbers, labels, selected state, and latest flags are reconstructable from external_metadata.selects mainDoc options with 0 mismatches in the 50-sample set. Prefer external_metadata.selects as the single document option source.
rows.keep_if: A downstream workflow explicitly needs a normalized convenience field and accepts duplication.

rows.reason: The same attachment document numbers, labels, and selected state are reconstructable from external_metadata.selects attachedDoc options with 0 mismatches in the 50-sample set.
rows.keep_if: A downstream workflow explicitly needs a normalized convenience field and accepts duplication.

rows.reason: Current examples are empty, but future source row metadata may be needed for joins, filtering, or audit context.
rows.source: source disclosure result JSON or result directory rows

rows.reason: Meta tags are generally static KIND page metadata, browser hints, or service descriptions rather than disclosure-specific values.
rows.keep_if: A meta value is proven to contain disclosure-specific identifiers or filing state in real samples.

rows.reason: Form name/id/action/method are usually static viewer shell structure.
rows.keep_if: Action or another form attribute varies by disclosure and is required to reproduce a fetch.

rows.reason: Form-scoped inputs duplicate external_metadata.inputs in the 50-sample set, and the variable values mostly duplicate top-level acpt_no/title or empty/static viewer controls.
rows.keep_if: A future sample contains a non-empty, non-duplicated form input value required for document fetches or parser context.

rows.reason: Form-scoped selects duplicate external_metadata.selects in the 50-sample set; keep the top-level selects as the canonical document option source.
rows.keep_if: A future sample has form-scoped select context that cannot be reconstructed from external_metadata.selects.

rows.reason: Usually absent or static UI payload; not known to be necessary for per-disclosure storage.
rows.keep_if: Real samples show disclosure-specific values in textarea text or attributes.

rows.reason: Button labels and attributes are typically repeated UI controls.
rows.keep_if: A button carries disclosure-specific state in attributes.

rows.reason: Real examples mostly contain empty/static hidden controls plus acptNo and tempTitle, which duplicate acpt_no and title.
rows.keep_if: A future sample contains a non-empty, non-duplicated input value required for document fetches or parser context.

rows.reason: Select options encode per-disclosure document numbers, labels, latest flags, and selected state.
rows.extracted_information: Select id/name/attributes and option text/value/doc_no/latest_flag/selected state

rows.reason: Most anchors are repeated viewer controls such as print/PDF actions and do not identify the disclosure.
rows.extracted_information: Anchor attributes, visible text, and nested image attributes
rows.keep_if: href/onclick/text contains a disclosure-specific document number or unique fetch parameter.

rows.reason: Frame id/name/title usually describe static viewer layout rather than per-disclosure values.
rows.keep_if: src or another attribute contains disclosure-specific document state.

rows.reason: Images, styles, objects, embeds, and sources are generally repeated static assets.
rows.keep_if: A resource URL contains disclosure-specific document paths or file identifiers.

rows.reason: Script src/version references are usually common viewer implementation details.
rows.keep_if: A script URL contains disclosure-specific parameters.

rows.reason: Full inline script text can be bulky and commonly includes repeated viewer logic. In the 50-sample set, extracted simple variables are also redundant with acpt_no/static values.
rows.keep_if: The inline script contains non-extractable disclosure-specific values that are not available in top-level fields, inputs, or selects.

rows.reason: Per-script variables exactly duplicate the flattened external_metadata.script_variables sequence in the 50-sample set. The only per-disclosure value is _TRK_PN, which equals records[].acpt_no; the rest are static, empty, or common messages.
rows.source: inline JavaScript var assignments inside each script
rows.keep_if: A future workflow needs to retain which specific script tag produced each variable, or new samples show non-duplicated script variables.

rows.reason: In the 50-sample set, text blocks are mostly repeated KIND UI/status notices plus company/title text already available from header/title. Non-final status can be inferred from mainDoc latest/selected information in external_metadata.selects, so this adds no non-duplicated storage value.
rows.source: direct text from selected text-bearing tags
rows.extracted_information: Tag name, attributes, and direct text for button/caption/dd/dt/headings/label/li/p/span/td/th
rows.keep_if: Future samples contain non-repeated status text that cannot be inferred from title/header/select metadata.

rows.reason: In the 50-sample set, the only per-disclosure variable is _TRK_PN and it always equals records[].acpt_no. Other variables are static, empty, or common PDF/viewer messages, so the flattened list adds no non-duplicated storage value.
rows.source: inline JavaScript var assignments across scripts
rows.keep_if: Future samples contain non-duplicated script variables that are required for fetches, parser context, or audit.

rows.reason: Compact integrity key for verifying the source HTML without retaining full wrapper HTML.
rows.extracted_information: SHA-256 hash of the original viewer HTML

rows.reason: Small sanity-check field for storage impact and source completeness.
rows.extracted_information: Original viewer HTML size in bytes

discard: records[].external_metadata.inputs unless non-duplicated variable values appear
records[].external_metadata.scripts[].variables unless non-duplicated variable provenance is needed
records[].external_metadata.text_blocks unless non-duplicated status text appears
